title: Adversary Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Adversary standalone module.

challenger_mode.description: open = challenge on own merits; spec-bound = challenge against spec_artifact

spec_artifact_path.description: Path to ground truth spec. null when challenger_mode = open

challenges_produced.description: Total number of challenge points raised across all four domains

challenge_domains_covered.description: All four domains must be true for a complete analysis

anchoring_prevention_applied.description: Must be true. false = invariant violation ADV-1. Adversary received output only, no reasoning context.

strong_output_acknowledged.description: true when Adversary found no real weaknesses. Permits empty counter_analysis arrays.

weaknesses.description: What could go wrong with this approach

unstated_assumptions.description: Assumptions taken as given without stating them

failure_scenarios.description: Conditions under which the output fails. Format: If X, then Y breaks because Z.
